description: Canonical Android offline sync payload for replaying a stage transition and activity log against an existing offline-created crop cycle in android-dynamic-test.

android_contract.stage_addressing_recommendation: Use payload.stage_code=NURSERY for offline replay. stage_id/entity_id is optional and server-generated; stage_code is more stable for Android offline drafts.
android_contract.crop_stage_entity_id: Optional. If supplied, it may be the server CropStageInstance id. For offline replay after crop_cycle create, omit entity_id and use payload.crop_cycle_id + payload.stage_code.
android_contract.activity_entity_id: Required/recommended. Use Android local UUID so idempotent replay preserves activity identity.
dependency_ordering: crop_cycle create event must be accepted before stage transition.
crop_stage transition should depend on crop_cycle create event_id when sent in one ordered batch or when Android wants explicit ordering.
crop_activity create should depend on the crop_stage transition event_id so the backend starts the stage before logging the stage-linked activity.
android_contract.activity_dependency_rule: Activity may technically link by crop_cycle_id + stage_code once the cycle stages exist, but Android should depend on the stage transition event_id for this Maestro flow.
android_contract.random_android_activity_ids: Supported. The WSL verifier defaults to checking the latest NURSERY activity with cost 325.50. If Android wants exact UUID checks, run verifier with ANDROID_ACTIVITY_EVENT_ID and ANDROID_ACTIVITY_ID env vars.

payload.notes: Android offline replay start Nursery Preparation
Android offline replay activity under Nursery Preparation

wsl_verification_command_with_exact_andr: cd ~/projects/farmint/backend && ANDROID_ACTIVITY_EVENT_ID={android event uuid} ANDROID_ACTIVITY_ID={android activity uuid} ../venv/bin/python scripts/verify_android_offline_stage_activity_replay.py
